description: When daily_sync_job catches an exception (SimpleFIN timeout, auth error, etc.), send an email with the error message so dead syncs don't go unnoticed. Today you only know by opening /. Edge cases: don't spam if the sync fails repeatedly — maybe once per failure streak, or at most once per day. Also consider sending a 'back to healthy' email when sync recovers after a failure.
title: Sync failure email
